name: Solidgate
noGoogleReason: Solidgate has no Google Business Profile. Searching for it in Kyiv or anywhere else returns nothing under the name, so there is no listing to read.

reddit.heading: What Reddit says about Solidgate
reddit.summary: One post, and it is worth the section on its own. In February 2026 a developer released a Ruby SDK for Solidgate, explaining that he wrote it after finding no existing one while migrating a project off Braintree. That is a small fact with a practical edge: if you are on Rails, the client library you integrate against is a stranger's side project rather than something Solidgate ships and maintains. Everything else the searches return is Solidgate recruiting, from a batch of job adverts posted to a jobs aggregator in late 2022. There is no merchant on Reddit describing onboarding, settlement, chargeback handling or support, in either direction. For a processor aimed at subscription and digital businesses that is a genuine gap rather than a good sign, and it means Reddit cannot tell you anything about the parts that matter most.
reddit.volumeNote: One substantive post. The rest is the company's own recruitment.

threads.title: A Ruby Gem to work with Solidgate Payments
threads.takeaway: A developer migrating off Braintree found no Ruby SDK for Solidgate and wrote one. Check what official client libraries exist for your stack before committing.

themes.label: Check the SDK for your language
themes.detail: The one useful finding: no Ruby SDK existed as of February 2026, and the one that does now is a third party's.
